name: Phase Function
definition: A function describing the angular distribution of light scattering at any point $x$ within a medium. It gives the fraction of incoming light traveling along direction $\omega'$ that is scattered into direction $-\omega$ (towards the eye).
summary: A phase function describes the angular distribution of light scattering in a medium, distinguishing itself by modeling anisotropic behavior where light preferentially scatters forward or backward rather than equally in all directions.
